name: Bricked Multiresolution Tensor Approximation
definition: A data management system that divides large volumetric datasets into small cubical bricks (subvolumes), approximates each brick using rank-reduced Tucker decomposition, and organizes them into an out-of-core octree structure to enable interactive visualization.
summary: Bricked Multiresolution Tensor Approximation is a data management technique that compresses volumetric data into cubical bricks using Tucker decomposition and an octree, enabling interactive visualization via on-demand GPU reconstruction.
